title: Polish Sausage Tagine
description: A unique twist on the traditional Italian sausage, this recipe combines the flavors of Poland with the spices of North Africa.
instructions: Heat the yields in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped red pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Polish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the sausage is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
